description: This file defines monitoring counters and statistics classes for the Torch library, including enumerations for aggregations, a hash struct, and a template class for statistical data collection and logging.

classes.name: Stat
classes.description: A template class for computing and logging statistical summaries over fixed intervals, supporting types double and int64_t.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to the current window, updating statistics accordingly.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistic.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the current window.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current statistical data as a map.
